title: 🦉 Early Bird vs. Night Owl (Which One Are You?) #Shorts #EnglishLearning

subtitles.en:
Oh, wow... Alex, you look absolutely terrible
today!
subtitles.zh: 噢，天啊……Alex，你今天看起來真的超憔悴的！

subtitles.en:
Thanks... Well, I didn't go to bed until,
like, 2 AM.
subtitles.zh: 謝謝喔……唉，我大概到凌晨兩點才睡。
真的假的？你到底在忙什麼啊？

subtitles.en: Oh, you know... just binge-watching movies.
subtitles.zh: 噢，就……一直熬夜看電影啊。

subtitles.en: Wow... you are definitely a total night owl!
subtitles.zh: 哇……你絕對是個徹頭徹尾的夜貓子！

subtitles.en: A... night owl? What do you mean?
subtitles.zh: 夜……夜貓子？妳是什麼意思？

subtitles.en:
Yes! You know, someone who stays up super
late.
subtitles.zh: 對啊！就是指那種……習慣熬夜到超晚的人。

subtitles.en: Ah, got it. So... then what are you?
subtitles.zh: 啊，懂了。那……妳又是哪一種人？

subtitles.en: Oh, me? I'm 100% an early bird!
subtitles.zh: 噢，我嗎？我可是百分之百的晨型人！

subtitles.en: Oh yeah? What time do you even wake up?
subtitles.zh: 喔是嗎？那你到底都幾點起床啊？
早上六點……每一天都是喔！

subtitles.en:
Well, you know what they say, the early bird
catches the worm!
subtitles.zh: 嗯哼，俗話說得好——早起的鳥兒有蟲吃嘛！

subtitles.en:
Well... the night owl gets to watch all the
cool movies.
subtitles.zh: 嗯……但夜貓子可以看到所有酷炫的電影啊。

subtitles.en: Fair point! Haha... so, what about you guys?

Are you an early bird... or a night owl? Tell
us below!
subtitles.zh: 你是早起派……還是夜貓子呢？在下方留言告訴我們吧！

subtitles.en: And don't forget to subscribe for more!
subtitles.zh: 還有別忘了訂閱我們收聽更多內容喔！
